scope: Radius-one finite-bath cubic throat, baseline inward intake 0.25, saved deep shear-order field, common translation and two lateral bends, quasi-static material shear and unit local grip. The incoming rest slip is zero. Traveling-reference and fixed-site laws differ by transport. One marker transit from the waist to w=2 sets the hypothesized renewal time. No wave occupation or bare wall mass.

conventions.force: Carrier force required for measured trajectory minus externally applied force equals force of attachment on moving wall. Wall force is also obtained by integration of its stress. Equivalent forces at entrance, middle and flare are conjugate to gauge displacements and do not localize the traction.
conventions.wall_band: Upstream means actual wall area between the waist and w=1.175. The resultant on the downstream guide is opposite. The band integral is a separate material-field readout. It is distinct from carrier momentum passing through a cross section.
conventions.time: The smooth pulse peaks at 4 and ends at 8. Late station-force values average adjacent midpoint readings. Motion and spatial band readings are endpoints. Fine and coarse last samples differ slightly in time.
conventions.units: Station displacement, band force and equivalent station force are divided by peak pulse force 1e-9. Printed pulse energies and work are divided by that force squared. A growing sinusoidal force of the same peak with exponent .30+.40i is switched on at time -96.
conventions.energy: Signed transport work belongs to motion of the prescribed reference. Algebraic energy closure of the discrete equations does not select a physical supply.
